# Drain Damage 0.138.0 — macOS prototype

Download and extract `Drain-Damage-0.138.0-macos-universal.zip`, then drag **Drain Damage.app** into Applications.
Godot and developer tools are not required. Confirm the title screen shows **v0.138.0**.

The app is ad-hoc signed, without Developer ID signing or notarization. If macOS blocks the first opening and you
trust this download, use **System Settings → Privacy & Security → Open Anyway** after attempting to open it.
Do not disable Gatekeeper globally. Report any damaged-app or malware alert with its exact wording.

The package contains Apple Silicon and Intel executables. Declared minimum versions are macOS 13 on Apple Silicon
and macOS 11 on Intel. Intel execution, minimum OS versions and fresh-machine installation are unverified for this build.

This unfinished prototype includes Level 1 and its bosses, plus the Level 2 flush, landing and 13-encounter ride.
Choose Tony or Sean and use the in-game Controls menu. Full uninterrupted survival, physical controllers and subjective
audio mixing remain testing gaps. See the release manifest for exact automated and visual coverage.

When reporting bugs, include the version, Mac model, macOS version, selected hero/difficulty and reproduction steps.
